Define a taper equation written as an R function

Source: R/stem-model.R
new_taper_model.Rd

Define a taper equation written as an R function

Usage

new_taper_model(
  id,
  family,
  dib,
  dob = NULL,
  height_at_dib = NULL,
  volume = NULL,
  inputs = list(required = character(), optional = character(), pairs = list()),
  spcd = integer(),
  stump_ht = 1,
  bark_ratio = NA_real_,
  source = ''
)

Arguments

id

The identifier names the taper model in the registry. Character vector of model identifiers. Required, with no default.

family

The family groups taper models that use the same equation form. Character vector of family names. Required, with no default.

dib

The callback computes inside diameter along the stem. R function accepting dbh, ht, measurement arguments, and aux, with diameters in inches, heights in feet, and volumes in cubic feet. Required, with no default.

dob

The callback computes outside diameter along the stem. R function accepting dbh, ht, measurement arguments, and aux, with diameters in inches, heights in feet, and volumes in cubic feet. Default: NULL.

height_at_dib

The callback finds height from inside diameter. R function accepting dbh, ht, measurement arguments, and aux, with diameters in inches, heights in feet, and volumes in cubic feet. Default: NULL.

volume

The callback computes volume between two heights. R function accepting dbh, ht, measurement arguments, and aux, with diameters in inches, heights in feet, and volumes in cubic feet. Default: NULL.

inputs

The input declaration lists additional measurements the model needs. List with required and optional character vectors and a list of paired input names. Default: list(required = character(), optional = character(), pairs = list()).

spcd

The species codes limit the trees this model covers. Numeric vector of species codes. Default: integer().

stump_ht

Stump height above ground. Numeric vector, feet. Default: 1.

bark_ratio

The bark ratio estimates inside diameter from outside diameter when needed. Numeric scalar, inside diameter divided by outside diameter. Default: NA_real_.

source

The source records where the model came from. Character scalar, provenance text. Default: ''.

Value

A validated taper_model list containing id, family, kernel (callbacks), inputs, spcd, stump_ht (feet), bark_ratio (diameter ratio), source (provenance), and internal equation metadata.

Examples

## Inspect the shipped demonstration callback
base <- get_taper_model(id = 'demo.paraboloid.r')

## Construct a local model from the callback
local_model <- new_taper_model(id = 'example.callback',
                               family = 'demonstration',
                               dib = base$dib)

## Inspect the local model
print(local_model)
#> <taper_model example.callback>
#>   family: demonstration
#>   kernel: r
#>   units: imperial
#>   oracle verified: not applicable
#>   capabilities: dib
